sponsoredBills.summary: The bill directs the Federal Aviation Administration to establish a voluntary flight deck training program allowing certified air traffic controllers to observe operations aboard commercial and general aviation aircraft. Participating controllers would be considered on-duty during flights and could observe at least one round trip within U.S. territories.
sponsoredBills.title: FLIGHT DECK Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

sponsoredBills.summary: Requires primary ticket sellers to disclose, at least seven days before tickets go on sale, the total number of available tickets and total cost per ticket. Prohibits withholding ticket sales to inflate prices or conceal ticket availability. Empowers the Federal Trade Commission to enforce these requirements as unfair or deceptive practices.
sponsoredBills.title: HOLDBACKS Act
